text: this mug was never designed yo fit those stupid travel cup holders. First, this mug was never designed yo fit those stupid travel cup holders, second, you must remove the lid to take a drink, third it is not well insulated but is better than a plain glass mug at keeping your coffee hot.  it is great as a mug for your desk that takes the place of the old standard glass mug.
